# Health Hub
> 540+ Free, Medically Verified Online Health, Fitness, Nutrition & Clinical Calculators.

- Website: https://health-hub.calculatorfree.in/
- Sitemap: https://health-hub.calculatorfree.in/sitemap.xml
- Network: Calculator Free (https://www.calculatorfree.in/)

## Overview
Health Hub is an open, evidence-based health estimation platform featuring 540+ specialized calculators across body composition, diet, calories, macronutrients, clinical scores, pediatrics, pregnancy, sports performance, and sleep. All biometric estimations occur client-side in the user's browser, ensuring 100% personal data privacy.

## Categories & High-Authority Health Tools

### 1. Body Composition & Weight
- BMI Calculator: https://health-hub.calculatorfree.in/bmi-calculator
  - Accurately calculates Body Mass Index with WHO and Asian-population thresholds.
- BMR Calculator: https://health-hub.calculatorfree.in/bmr-calculator
  - Calculates resting basal metabolic rate via Mifflin-St Jeor and Harris-Benedict formulas.
- TDEE Calculator: https://health-hub.calculatorfree.in/tdee-calculator
  - Evaluates Total Daily Energy Expenditure factoring in lifestyle physical activity multipliers.
- Body Fat Calculator: https://health-hub.calculatorfree.in/body-fat-calculator
  - U.S. Navy circumference method (neck, waist, hip measurements).
- Ideal Body Weight: https://health-hub.calculatorfree.in/ideal-weight-calculator
  - Devine, Robinson, Miller, and Hamwi equations.
- Child & Teen BMI Percentile: https://health-hub.calculatorfree.in/child-bmi-calculator
  - CDC growth percentiles for ages 2 to 19.

### 3. Fitness, Workouts & Strength

## Clinical & Medical Disclaimer
All calculations, biometric estimates, and clinical risk models on Health Hub are intended solely for educational, fitness screening, and wellness tracking purposes. They do not constitute professional medical advice, clinical diagnosis, or medical treatment plans. Always consult a licensed medical physician or certified healthcare provider.
